text:
In garden’s hush, the wild winds speak,
To ears that seek the truth they seek.
The flowers bloom, a silent vow,
Unfurling grace to show the now.

The trees stand guard, ancient and still,
Their rustling leaves, a whispered will.
Here solace finds its quiet home,
In roots that in the dark have grown.

Life turns its wheel, a cycle deep,
In promises the blossoms keep.
Each leaf that falls, each petal’s rise,
Reflects the passing of the skies.

The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.
